text: In 1962, America's top military chiefs signed off on a plan... to attack America. Not for real. They wanted to fake it. Staged hijackings. Bombs in Miami. [whispers] Even funerals for victims who never existed. The plan was called Operation Northwoods. President Kennedy rejected it... and the file stayed secret for thirty-five years.

designs.description: Deep, calm American male narrator in his 40s with a slight gravel. Measured, deliberate pace, low and intimate, like an investigator reading classified files late at night. Clean studio recording, documentary tone.
